snippet.title: PESKY ORCS! - Indiegame Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist "PESKY ORCS!" on Steam now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4184880/PESKY_ORCS/

In "Pesky Orcs!" you take part in medieval fantasy battles between ancient foes:

Orcs and humans.

As commander of the human army you do not control your soldiers directly. Instead lead them across the battlefield where they attack enemies automatically and help them avoid projecticles, traps and spells. You yourself are busy activating spells and collecting loot in form of coins, diamonds and other treasure.

Lost a battle? No problem. In between runs visit your cozy homebase where you can trade your coin in for new buildings that unlock upgrades and units. Returning to the battlefield you will be mightier than ever before. Let those Orcs quiver in fear!

Features:

unique blend of RTS, RPG and Autobattler

Roguelike/Roguelite Elements

handcrafted retro pixelart look!

Loads of units, buildings, spells & fun!

randomizes battlefields in different worlds for maximum variety

runs on a potato

driving soundtrack

hours of fun with new content updates already on the horizon!

How long will YOU survive against the hordes of darkness?

Enter the world of "Pesky Orcs!" today and dive into a blizzard of retro fun! Wink wink.
